aliasing.description: places record writes and mutable borrows, with what a reference or pointer reaches marked as escaping; reads have no places, and what two pointers share isn't tracked

constant-values.description: literals, enumerators and integer constants read where they're used; other constant expressions are not evaluated

dispatch.description: a virtual call is dynamic, and names an implementation only where Clang can devirtualize it

evaluation-order.description: the CFG follows C++17 where it specifies an order, and left to right where the language leaves it unspecified, as for function arguments

exceptional-flow.description: throw, and calls in a try's body, have edges to its handlers; a call outside any try has no exception edge, and destructors running during unwinding aren't shown

generic-instances.description: a template's body is emitted once from its pattern; instances are not recorded

implicit-calls.description: implicit conversions, constructors and destructors are calls the compiler writes, where they run: a scope's end, before a jump out of one, and a temporary's full expression. A conditional temporary's is counted as if it were made, a local a return elides still gets one, what runs during unwinding isn't shown, and what a template hasn't settled is an unresolved call

integer-semantics.description: widths and signedness come from Clang; unsigned overflow wraps, and signed overflow is undefined, so a bound holds for executions without it

macro-provenance.description: a macro's own tokens carry its expansion, and what a macro is handed stays source

mutability.description: const is the source's word; anything else is immutable when nothing replaces it, takes its address, borrows it mutably or writes part of its own value. A non-const method of a workspace type counts as a mutable borrow

resolution.description: no compilation database, so the compile flags were guessed: expect missing headers, and functions and calls lost to them

types.description: no compilation database, so the compile flags were guessed

ast.description: every statement and expression of each function with a body; constructs with no neutral kind are registered cxx: extensions or unsupported nodes that keep what they hold

cfg.description: edges between a function's own nodes; a closure's body is a flow of its own, since it runs when called, and a function a macro or the compiler writes keeps the same rules

evidence.description: coverage per document, with an override per function

method.description: identity, spans, parameters, receiver, result and template parameters

place.description: writes and mutable or raw borrows; reads have no places

ref.description: identifiers and calls; a dependent reference names its candidate when lookup found one, and a function value's target stays unresolved

symbol.description: locals, parameters and the receiver, with an access per reference

type.description: canonical types; workspace records list their fields, and library ones don't

unit.description: no compilation database: translation units come from the source tree, with guessed flags

value.description: literals, enumerators and integer constants only
